seoTitle: That '70s Show Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the That '70s Show test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Eric, Donna, Kelso, Hyde, Jackie, Fez, Red or Kitty — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the nice guy, the rebel, or the one shouting 'Burn!'? Answer 12 everyday questions about friends, family and Friday nights, and find out which That '70s Show character you are.

characters.name: Eric Forman
characters.title: The Nice Guy
characters.summary: Sweet, nerdy and funnier than people expect. You're a bit clumsy, but your heart is always in the right place.
description: Like Eric, you're the nice one. He's a nerdy, accident-prone teenager with a very dry sense of humour.
You're loyal to the people you love. Eric's long relationship with Donna, the girl next door, is at the centre of the show.
You go out and find yourself. At the end of season 7, Eric leaves to teach in Africa, and he comes back in the finale to reunite with Donna.
characters.flaw: You'd rather make a joke than stand up for yourself.
characters.signature: A dry one-liner, a nervous laugh and the Vista Cruiser your dad handed down to you.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a sarcastic joke right when you needed them to back you up

characters.name: Donna Pinciotti
characters.title: The Cool Girl
characters.summary: Smart, independent and completely unbothered. You do your own thing, and you don't need anyone's permission.
description: Like Donna, you're cool without trying. She's smart, strong-minded and one of the boys.
You stand up for what you believe in. Donna is a proud feminist, and she won't let anyone talk down to her.
You chase your own dreams. Donna works at a radio station, and after a long on-off relationship, she and Eric reunite in the finale.
characters.flaw: You keep your options open so long that people can't tell where they stand.
characters.signature: A flannel shirt, a radio on and an opinion you're happy to share.
characters.clashReason: they'd shoot down your idea with one very sensible sentence

characters.name: Kelso
characters.title: The Lovable Idiot
characters.summary: Good-looking, fun and not the sharpest. You act first, think later, and somehow land on your feet.
description: Like Kelso, you know you look good. He relies on his looks far more than his brains.
You love a good burn. Whenever someone gets insulted or pranked, Kelso is there to point and shout 'Burn!'
You grow up, sort of. Kelso becomes a dad to a daughter, Betsy, works as a police officer for a while, and eventually leaves for a security job in Chicago.
characters.flaw: You do the dumb thing first, every single time.
characters.signature: A van, a mirror and a very loud 'Burn!'
characters.clashReason: they'd prank you, then shout 'Burn!' in your face

characters.name: Hyde
characters.title: The Rebel
characters.summary: Sarcastic, clever and suspicious of everything. You act like you don't care, but you'd do anything for your friends.
description: Like Hyde, you don't trust anyone in charge. He's anti-establishment, very sarcastic, and the smartest and most practical one in the group.
You're tougher than you look. Hyde moves in with the Formans after his mother walks out on him.
You find your way. Hyde meets his biological father, WB, and ends up running the Grooves record store.
characters.flaw: You'd rather act like you don't care than admit you're hurt.
characters.signature: A pair of sunglasses, a record collection and a theory about who's really in charge.
characters.clashReason: they'd act like nothing you said mattered to them, even when it did

characters.name: Jackie Burkhart
characters.title: The Princess
characters.summary: Bossy, dramatic and fabulous. You know what you want, and you're not shy about telling everyone.
description: Like Jackie, you've got high standards. She starts the show spoiled, self-centred and very sure she's the best.
You get knocked down and get back up. When Jackie's father is sent to jail, she gets a job and starts to grow up.
You keep your friends close. Jackie dates Kelso, Hyde and Fez over the years, and becomes best friends with Donna.
characters.flaw: You think your opinion is a fact, and you'll explain why at length.
characters.signature: A perfect outfit, a strong opinion and a boyfriend she's trying to improve.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you what was wrong with your outfit, then offer to fix your whole life

characters.name: Fez
characters.title: The Sweet Outsider
characters.summary: Sweet, odd and a total romantic. You love candy, your friends and the idea of true love.
description: Like Fez, you're a bit of an outsider, and you make it work. He's a foreign exchange student, and his home country is never revealed.
You love the simple things. Fez's love of candy is one of the show's running jokes.
You never give up on love. Fez is in love with Jackie for most of the series, and in the final season they finally get together.
characters.flaw: You believe whatever people tell you, especially if it involves candy.
characters.signature: A bag of candy, a big smile and a crush you never got over.
characters.clashReason: they'd eat all your snacks, then look at you like you'd hurt their feelings

characters.name: Red Forman
characters.title: The Grump
characters.summary: Strict, short-tempered and secretly soft. You want a quiet life, and you're surrounded by people who won't give you one.
description: Like Red, you don't suffer fools. He's a Navy veteran with a very short temper, who's always threatening to put his foot somewhere painful.
You have simple pleasures. Red is a huge Green Bay Packers fan, and he just wants to watch the game in peace.
You care more than you'd ever say. Red is grumpy with everyone, but there's a soft side underneath, and he takes in Hyde when he has nowhere else to go.
characters.flaw: You'd rather shout than say anything nice out loud.
characters.signature: A favourite armchair, a Packers game and a threat involving your foot.
characters.clashReason: they'd call you an idiot to your face, then quietly fix your problem

characters.name: Kitty Forman
characters.title: The Mum of the Group
characters.summary: Warm, cheerful and always ready with a snack. You look after everyone, but don't push you too far.
description: Like Kitty, you look after everyone. She's a nurse, and she mothers all of Eric's friends, especially Fez and Hyde.
You're cheerful, mostly. Kitty is warm and upbeat, but she can turn cold and fierce when she's pushed too far.
You hold the family together. Kitty keeps the Forman house running, whoever turns up in the basement.
characters.flaw: You worry about everyone so much that you forget to look after yourself.
characters.signature: A tray of snacks, a warm hug and a look that means you've gone too far.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep feeding you long after you'd said you were full

questions.text: Your friends are all hanging out at someone's house on a Friday night. You...

options.text: Make the sarcastic comments that keep everyone laughing
Pull a prank on whoever isn't looking
Bring snacks for everyone and check they've all eaten
Want everyone gone by nine so you can have some peace

questions.text: Your boss criticises your work. You...

options.text: Make a dry joke about it, then quietly feel terrible
Tell them they're wrong. You're clearly amazing
Not even notice you're being criticised
Work twice as hard and prove them wrong
A long drive with the radio up and nowhere to be
Shopping, then telling everyone what you bought
Watching the game in your chair. Nobody touches the remote
A mountain of candy and a scary film

questions.text: A friend makes a really dumb mistake. You...

options.text: Tell them exactly how dumb that was, at full volume
Tell them it'll all be fine, then give them a very firm talking-to
Laugh. Then point and laugh some more
Don't say much. Just help them sort it out

questions.text: You have a crush on someone who's already taken. You...

options.text: Wait patiently. However long it takes, your time will come
Act like you couldn't care less
Move on. You've got better things to do
Say something awkward every time they're around

questions.text: Someone gives you advice you didn't ask for. You...

options.text: Give them some advice back, about their hair
Thank them, then do whatever you were going to do anyway
Go along with it. Arguing is more effort
Ignore it completely. You've been doing this longer than they have

questions.text: You're asked to look after a friend's house while they're away. You...

options.text: Throw a party. They'll never know
Look in on the neighbours too while you're there
Check every lock twice. Nobody's breaking in on your watch
Invite your crush over and pretend it's your place

questions.text: A friend asks for help with something you're terrible at. You...

options.text: Try, fail, and somehow make it worse
Act like an expert. How hard can it be?
Say no. It's really not your thing, and that's fine
Help anyway, with lots of enthusiasm and very little skill

questions.text: There's a big news story everyone's talking about. You...

options.text: Explain who's really behind it
Have a strong opinion, and argue it well
Ask what it's about, then get it completely wrong
Worry about it, then call everyone you love to check they're okay
Expect a huge party, with you at the centre of it
Want a quiet night. No fuss and absolutely no singing
Spend the day making sure everyone else is having fun
Dance with absolutely everyone there

questions.text: It's the 1970s, you're a teenager in a small Wisconsin town, and your parents are away for the weekend. You...

options.text: Redecorate the living room your way before they get back
Have a few people round and keep it low-key
Enjoy the quiet house and finally get some writing done
Spend the whole weekend worrying about getting caught

questions.text: It's the 1970s, and you and your friends always hang out in one friend's basement. You...

options.text: Treat the place like your second home
Charm the mum so she keeps the snacks coming
Break something at least once a week
Apologise for everyone whenever the dad shouts about the noise
